$comment: Subject registry. A subject is level-independent; 'levels' lists the levels the IB offers for it. Every resource is tagged 'SL' (core: SL and HL students) or 'HL' (HL only). kind 'core' = DP core component (TOK, EE, CAS): no SL/HL split, stored as level SL ('for all students'). 'abbr' is the 2-letter badge in the subject picker. Add a subject by appending here and creating data/syllabi/<slug>.json, then run tools/check-syllabi.mjs. See docs/syllabus.md.
